title: Baseline diagnostic
blurb: 35-45 minutes. Route yourself to a study path with a short gap list-not a pass/fail test.

prompts.title: Walk through OAuth authorization code + PKCE (or your main login flow): actors, tokens, what can go wrong.
JWT: what you verify before trusting a token; one failure mode (algorithm or claim misuse).
CSRF vs XSS: different root cause and different primary defenses.
SQL injection: why parameterization fixes it; when it does not.
SSRF: attacker goal, one mitigation, one bypass you'd watch for.
IDOR: how you'd find it in review or test; one safe fix pattern.
Threat model one feature with STRIDE (pick any one letter and apply it).
Cloud: shared responsibility in one sentence + one customer-owned control you'd audit first.

scoreBands.label: Foundation first
scoreBands.advice: Prioritize Tier 1-2 topics tied to your 0-1 prompts. One timed drill a day.

scoreBands.label: Deepen the middle
scoreBands.advice: Keep path order, but add Tier 3-4 depth on role-specific topics. Mix Practice with Scenarios.

scoreBands.label: Performance mode
scoreBands.advice: Shift weight to Scenarios, OTM Lab, and Interview Round Playbook. Keep Quick Refs warm.
